mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE role IS NOT NULL) AS totalSysUser,# 系统用户数 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE role = 'owner') AS totalCustomers,# 客户人数 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE role = 'veterinarian') AS totalVeterinarian,# 兽医人数 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE role = 'foster_staff') AS totalFosterStaff,# 寄养员工人数 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE role IN ('veterinarian', 'foster_staff')) AS totalStaff,# 员工人数 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_order) AS totalOrder,# 订单数 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_order WHERE service_type = 'MEDICAL') AS totalMedicalOrders,# 医疗订单数 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_order WHERE service_type = 'FOSTER') AS totalFosterOrders,# 寄养订单数 (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM service_order) AS totalIncome,# 收入 (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM service_order WHERE service_type = 'MEDICAL') AS totalMedicalIncome,# 医疗收入 (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM service_order WHERE service_type = 'FOSTER') AS totalFosterIncome# 寄养收入

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rooms) AS totalRooms,# 房间数 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rooms WHERE status = 'available') AS availableRooms,# 可用房间数 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rooms WHERE status = 'occupied') AS occupiedRooms# 占用房间数
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_order WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() and status != 'canceled'
SELECT SUM(amount) FROM service_order WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() and status != 'canceled'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_order WHERE DATE(create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) and status != 'canceled'
SELECT SUM(amount) FROM service_order WHERE DATE(create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) and status != 'canceled'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE DATE(create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_order WHERE service_type = 'FOSTER' and DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_order WHERE service_type = 'MEDICAL' and DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM service_order GROUP BY status

SELECT si.service_name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM service_order as so left join service_item as si on so.service_id = si.id where so.service_id is not null GROUP BY so.service_id, si.service_name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE(create_time) as date, SUM(amount) as amount FROM service_order WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) and service_order.status = #{status} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date
